content: hreflang pitfalls confirmed from Google docs: (1) bidirectional linking — if two pages don't both point to each other, the tags are ignored; (2) missing x-default means unmatched-language users get no fallback; (3) relative URLs are invalid — must use fully-qualified https:// URLs; (4) self-referential hreflang required on every page variant; (5) language-only tags needed alongside region-specific ones (en alongside en-GB/en-AU). Next.js App Router uses alternates.languages in generateMetadata — metadataBase must be set in root layout or relative paths cause build errors. Missing metadataBase is the #1 cause of broken hreflang on Vercel deployments.
